title: Integrating Threatened Biodiversity in Monetary Ecosystem Accounting: Choice Experiments and Simulated Exchange Values
title_zh: 将受威胁生物多样性纳入货币化生态系统核算：选择实验与模拟交换价值
authors: Jose L. Oviedo, Pablo Campos, Alejandro Caparrós, Gonzalo M. Arroyo, Andrés De La Cruz
abstract: We present a valuation framework for measuring the non-market net operating surplus associated with threatened wild species preservation for monetary ecosystem accounting . We use the Simulated Exchange Value ( SEV ) method, which estimates the maximum benefit that could be internalized in a hypothetical market using the demand simulated from a choice experiment, a given market supply, and an assumed market structure. The choice experiment estimates willingness to pay (WTP), in addition to current tax-funded costs, for achieving different stock levels of wild species across threat categories defined by the International Union for Conservation of Nature Red List. We apply this framework to the valuation of threatened waterbird species preservation in the coastal wetlands of the southwestern Iberian Peninsula. The results show that WTP increases as the number of threatened species decreases, with the critically endangered species generating the highest WTP and no statistically significant differences between vulnerable and endangered species. Based on our preferred model, we estimate a SEV of the net operating surplus of €2,850 per hectare per year for the current stock levels of threatened waterbird species. The equivalent variation estimated for the same stock level is €4,108 per hectare per year.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种估值框架，用于衡量与受威胁野生物种保护相关的非市场净经营盈余，以服务于货币化生态系统核算。我们采用模拟交换价值（SEV）方法，该方法通过选择实验模拟的需求、给定的市场供给以及假定的市场结构，估算在假设市场中可内部化的最大收益。该选择实验估算了除当前税收资助成本之外，为实现国际自然保护联盟（IUCN）红色名录所定义的不同威胁类别野生物种存量水平而支付的意愿（WTP）。我们将此框架应用于伊比利亚半岛西南部沿海湿地受威胁水鸟物种保护的估值。结果显示，随着受威胁物种数量的减少，WTP增加，其中极危物种产生的WTP最高，而易危物种与濒危物种之间无统计学显著差异。基于我们的优选模型，我们估算出当前受威胁水鸟物种存量水平的净经营盈余SEV为每公顷每年2850欧元。同一存量水平下估算的等价变差为每公顷每年4108欧元。

title: Bank Runs With and Without Bank Failure
title_zh: 银行挤兑与银行倒闭：有与无
authors: Sergio A. Correia, Stephan Luck, Emil Verner
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the causes and consequences of bank runs. By applying large language models to historical newspapers, we create a comprehensive database of bank runs in U.S. history with information on 3,984 runs on individual banks from 1863 to 1934. Our novel data allow us to establish that runs are considerably more likely in weak banks but also occur in strong banks, especially in response to negative news about the real economy or the broader banking system. However, runs typically only result in failure for banks with poor fundamentals. Strong banks survive runs through various mechanisms, including signaling strength, interbank cooperation, and temporary suspension. At the local level, runs on banks with poor fundamentals translate into substantially larger declines in deposits, lending, and manufacturing activity than runs on strong banks. Our findings imply that poor fundamentals are central to explaining both when runs occur and when they have severe economic effects, tempering the view that small shocks can generate discontinuous jumps to bad equilibria through self-fulfilling run dynamics.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了银行挤兑的成因与后果。通过将大语言模型应用于历史报纸，我们构建了一个涵盖美国历史上银行挤兑事件的综合数据库，包含1863年至1934年间3984次针对单个银行的挤兑信息。这一全新数据使我们得以证实：挤兑更可能发生在弱势银行，但也会发生在强势银行，尤其是当实体经济或整个银行体系出现负面消息时。然而，挤兑通常仅导致基本面较差的银行倒闭。强势银行则通过多种机制存活，包括释放实力信号、银行间合作以及临时暂停营业。在地方层面，基本面较差的银行遭遇挤兑后，其存款、贷款和制造业活动的下降幅度显著大于强势银行遭遇挤兑的情况。我们的研究结果表明，基本面薄弱是解释挤兑何时发生以及何时产生严重经济影响的核心因素，这削弱了“小冲击可通过自我实现的挤兑动态引发向不良均衡的非连续跳跃”这一观点。

title: Do Workfare Programs Live Up to Their Promises? Experimental Evidence from Côte d’Ivoire
title_zh: 工作福利计划是否兑现了承诺？来自科特迪瓦的实验证据
authors: Bertrand, Marianne, Crépon, Bruno, Marguerie, Alicia, Premand, Patrick
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study contemporaneous and post-program impacts of a public works program, which provides urban youth seven months of employment at the formal minimum wage with complementary training on entrepreneurship or job search. During the program, we find limited impacts on employment, but a shift toward wage jobs, higher earnings and savings, as well as positive changes in work habits, behaviors, and well-being. After the program, we find no lasting impact on employment or behaviors, with only limited gains in earnings stemming from independent activities. Using machine learning to analyze heterogeneity, we show that alternative targeting approaches can substantially improve welfare.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一项公共工程项目在实施期间及结束后的影响。该项目为城市青年提供为期七个月的正式最低工资就业，并辅以创业或求职培训。在项目实施期间，我们发现其对就业的影响有限，但促使就业向工资性工作转移，提高了收入和储蓄，并在工作习惯、行为及福祉方面产生了积极变化。项目结束后，就业或行为方面未发现持久影响，仅从独立活动中获得有限的收入增长。通过机器学习分析异质性，我们表明替代性的目标定位方法可以显著改善福利。

title: Monopolistic Data Dumping
title_zh: 垄断性数据倾销
authors: Eliaz, Kfir, Spiegler, Ran
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: A profit-maximizing monopolist curates a database for users seek- ing to learn a parameter. There are two user types: "Nowcasters" wish to learn the parameter's current value, while "forecasters" target its long-run value. Data storage involves a constant marginal cost. The monopolist designs a menu of contracts described by fees and data-access levels. The profit-maximizing menu o¤ers full access to historical data, while current data is fully provided to nowcasters but may be withheld from forecasters. Compared to the social optimum, the monopolist keeps too much historical data, too little current data, and may store too much data overall.
abstract_zh: 一个追求利润最大化的垄断者为试图学习某个参数的用户构建数据库。用户分为两类："即时预测者"希望了解该参数的当前值，而"长期预测者"则关注其长期值。数据存储涉及恒定的边际成本。垄断者设计了一套由费用和数据访问权限组成的合同菜单。利润最大化的菜单提供对历史数据的完全访问，同时当前数据被完全提供给即时预测者，但可能对长期预测者有所保留。与社会最优相比，垄断者保留了过多的历史数据、过少的当前数据，并且整体上可能存储了过多的数据。

title: Organizational Incentives and the Returns to Technology Adoption
title_zh: 组织激励与技术采纳的回报
authors: Achyuta Adhvaryu, Smit Gade, Piyush Gandhi, Teresa Molina, Anant Nyshadham
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Misaligned incentives within organizations may explain why firms fail to adopt or fully benefit from productive technologies. We conducted a randomized controlled trial in Indian garment factories in which units received an anonymous worker-management communication technology, this technology paired with incentives for HR managers to communicate effectively with workers, or neither (control). We find that the technology alone had no impacts relative to control. But pairing the technology with HR incentives increased productivity by 5%, reduced absenteeism by 13%, and raised worker earnings by 3%. Impacts were driven by greater HR responsiveness and increased worker reporting of production-related issues.
abstract_zh: 组织内部的激励错位可能解释了企业为何未能采纳或充分受益于高效技术。我们在印度服装工厂开展了一项随机对照试验，其中部分工厂获得匿名员工-管理层沟通技术，部分工厂在技术基础上附加对人力资源经理有效沟通的激励措施，其余工厂则未获得任何干预（对照组）。研究发现，仅提供技术本身相较于对照组未产生显著影响。但将技术与人力资源激励相结合后，生产率提升5%，缺勤率降低13%，工人收入增加3%。这些影响源于人力资源响应度的提高以及工人对生产相关问题报告频率的增加。

title: Learning Camp, Language of Instruction, and Education Outcomes: Evidence from a Field Experiment in Malawi
title_zh: 学习营、教学语言与教育成果：来自马拉维田野实验的证据
authors: Hyuncheol Bryant Kim, Seonghoon Kim
abstract: We conducted a randomized experiment to study the impacts of a summer learning camp and the language of instruction on education outcomes. The program, covering social studies and mathematics, provided additional high-quality learning time for 4th and 5th graders in Malawi. The program significantly increased test scores in social studies and mathematics (0.24–0.36 standard deviations). We find suggestive evidence that the impact on test scores in social studies was greater for students instructed in Chichewa, the local language, than for those instructed in English. However, we find no such evidence of differential impacts on test scores in mathematics by the language of instruction.
abstract_zh: 我们开展了一项随机实验，研究暑期学习营及教学语言对教育成果的影响。该项目涵盖社会研究和数学课程，为马拉维四、五年级学生提供了额外的高质量学习时间。实验结果显示，该项目显著提升了学生在社会研究和数学方面的测试成绩（效应量为0.24–0.36个标准差）。我们初步发现，以当地语言奇契瓦语授课的学生在社会研究测试成绩上的提升幅度大于以英语授课的学生。然而，在数学测试成绩方面，未发现教学语言导致差异化影响的证据。

title: An Empirical Model of Quantity Discounts with Large Choice Sets
title_zh: 大选择集下数量折扣的实证模型
authors: Alessandro Iaria, Ao Wang
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
abstract: We introduce a Generalized Nested Logit model of demand for bundles that can be estimated sequentially, eliminating the challenge of dimensionality due to large choice sets. We use it to investigate quantity discounts for carbonated soft drinks by simulating a counterfactual with linear pricing. The prices of small-volume UPCs (<2L) decrease by −29.2% while those of large-volume UPCs (≥2L) increase by +16.8%. Purchased quantities decrease by −19.5% and industry profit by −6.3%. Consumer surplus however reduces only moderately, suggesting that a ban on quantity discounts on sugary drinks may be a simple and effective policy to limit added sugar intake. Our calculations confirm that such a ban would be as effective as a sugar tax of 1.5/oz of added sugar and reduce added sugar intake by −17.4%. A nested logit model that mistakenly ignores joint purchases of UPCs within shopping trips would instead simulate a reduction in added sugar intake of only −3.9%.
abstract_zh: 本文提出一种广义嵌套Logit需求模型，用于估计捆绑商品的需求，该模型可通过序贯估计方法解决因选择集过大带来的维度问题。我们利用该模型研究碳酸饮料的数量折扣问题，通过模拟线性定价的反事实情景发现：小容量UPC（<2升）价格下降29.2%，而大容量UPC（≥2升）价格上涨16.8%。购买量减少19.5%，行业利润下降6.3%，但消费者剩余仅温和下降，这表明禁止含糖饮料的数量折扣可能是限制添加糖摄入的简单有效政策。我们的计算证实，该禁令的效果相当于对每盎司添加糖征收1.5美分的糖税，可使添加糖摄入量减少17.4%。若错误采用忽略购物行程中UPC联合购买的嵌套Logit模型，则模拟得出的添加糖摄入量降幅仅为3.9%。
